entities.summary: Antonio Reeves is an American professional basketball player for the Charlotte Hornets of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Greensboro Swarm of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Illinois State Redbirds and the Kentucky Wildcats, and was drafted 47th overall by the Orlando Magic in the 2024 NBA draft.
